Dreamwise Ebook Design
Brochures & Ebooks, Flyers
Brief
Design an engaging ebook and flyers for Dreamwise that help teenagers explore career options and support parents in guiding career conversations. The design should be clear, encouraging, and youth-friendly, with clean layouts, readable typography, and simple visuals that inspire curiosity, clarity, and confidence.
